opening.argument: The segment is clearly framed as a Nasdaq Trade Talks interview focused on supporting women in fintech, not as a viewer-directed financial offer. The host identifies the program as “NASDAQ Trade Talks” and as a global market reporter, while the on-screen topic concerns the “Importance of Supporting Women in FinTech.” A Wells Fargo guest describes organizational support for fintech initiatives and explains that its startup accelerator may fund selected startups, alongside connections, networking, mentorship, and financial support. The invitation to follow Trade Talks on Twitter is ordinary channel engagement and is not presented as a condition for accessing the startup activity.

citations.quote: Welcome to NASDAQ Trade Talks, I'm Jill Maladrino Global Market Reporter at NASDAQ.
